subject: How many bank accounts can we connect?

messages.name: Wonderland Media admin
messages.body: We're on Professional. How many bank feeds can we connect?

messages.name: Nora (Support Tier 2)
messages.body: Starter includes 2 connected bank feeds, Professional 10, and Enterprise unlimited. You're on Professional, so your limit is 10.

messages.name: Wonderland Media admin
messages.body: That's not great, but we'll use the workaround.
